description_en: Adds cards to a target group
name: AddCardToDirectionalGroup

parameters.help_en: The set of ICCIDs for the cards. The maximum number of ICCIDs is 200
parameters.help_zh: 卡号的iccid集合，数量小于等于200

parameters.help_en: The request serial number. This parameter supports idempotence
parameters.name: serial_no

parameters.help_en:
The method used to add the cards. Valid values:
NEW: imports only the cards that are pending grouping.
TRANSFER: imports all cards and removes them from their original groups
parameters.help_zh:
添加的方式：

NEW：仅导入其中待分组的卡

TRANSFER：全量导入（卡从原分组中删除）
parameters.name: add_type

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to push a notification through Message Queue (MQ) after the operation succeeds. Default value: false. Valid values:
false: does not push a notification.
true: pushes a notification
parameters.help_zh:
执行成功后是否通过MQ推送，默认false： 

false：不推送 

true： 推送（目前不支持）
parameters.name: msg_notify
